title: Error envelope
description:
Returned for any 4xx/5xx status code.  Two shapes coexist:
  (a) FastAPI default `{detail: '...'}` — used by 404 (record not found), 405 (method not allowed), 422 (validation).
  (b) Patched bad-query envelope `{error: 'bad_query_syntax', detail: '...'}` — used by the global exception handler when sqlite3.OperationalError leaks from FTS5.
Both shapes MUST include CORS headers when the request origin is approved (see test-plan §B.3).
